content.text: The cause is in `util.py`: `_parse_field` always returns `restricted=False`, so `day_ok` never filters by day-of-month or day-of-week. There's a second problem in `core.py`: when both fields are restricted it combines them with AND, but standard cron (Vixie/POSIX) uses OR in that case. I'll fix both.

I changed it to mark a field restricted unless it starts with `*`, which is the classic cron rule. I also changed `solution/core.py` so that when both day fields are restricted, a day matches if either one matches (OR), as in standard cron. The old code required both (AND).
